mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user_role (user_id, role_id, granted_by, reason, effective_from, effective_to, active_marker, version) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}, #{grantedBy}, #{reason}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{activeMarker}, #{version})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, role_id, granted_by, reason, effective_from, effective_to, active_marker, version FROM t_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND active_marker=1 AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) ORDER BY role_id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user_role SET active_marker=NULL,version=version+1 WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND active_marker=1 AND effective_to IS NOT NULL AND effective_to <= #{effectiveAt}

UPDATE t_user_role SET effective_to=CASE WHEN effective_from >= #{effectiveTo} THEN effective_to ELSE #{effectiveTo} END, active_marker=NULL, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND active_marker=1
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, role_id, granted_by, reason, effective_from, effective_to, active_marker, version FROM t_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND active_marker=1 AND (effective_from IS NULL OR effective_from <= #{effectiveAt}) AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) ORDER BY role_id

SELECT user_id FROM t_user_role WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND active_marker=1 AND (effective_from IS NULL OR effective_from <= #{effectiveAt}) AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) ORDER BY user_id
